description: Manifest for Bestiary data: NPC Unit profiles (Common NPCs, Common Creatures, Unusual Creatures, Large Monsters), the generic Monster upgrade reference, Elite/Alpha creature rules, and Animal Companions.

files.description: General Bestiary Rules, Tags, Shared Special Effects, Multiple Attack Profiles, and the per-section file manifest.
9 profiles: Civilians, Thugs, Bandits, Cultists, Acolytes, Veteran Guard, Assassin, Hedge Mage, Ogre Mercenary.
14 profiles: wilderness predators, swarms, and packs (Giant Rats through Hunting Raptors).
10 profiles: deceptive, mutated, and supernatural creatures (Mimic through Gargoyles).
17 boss and large-monster profiles, including the strengthened Young Dragon and Kraken, the Adult Dragon, Sea Serpent, and Elder Treant.
Reference-price upgrade table for GM-designed Monster variants.
The Alpha package for upgrading one Model in an eligible multi-model Beast Unit.
15 profiles across Small/Standard/Large Companions, plus Companion Upgrades and Mount Restrictions.
Provisional testing priorities for Bestiary Point costs.
